latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Remind Me skill: set natural language reminders.

- Logs all reminders to a markdown file for easy tracking.
- Understands both relative ("in 2 hours") and absolute ("tomorrow at 3pm") time formats.
- Provides manual commands to list, view, and remove reminders.
